newsitem.title: USA: Thomas & Betts plans $35 mln N.Y. expansion.
newsitem.headline: Thomas & Betts plans $35 mln N.Y. expansion.

text.p: Thomas & Betts Corp said on Friday it was planning a $35 million expansion of its Augat Electronics cable television (CATV) connector operations in New York, to boost capacity.

Under the expansion plans, the company said it would consolidate the operations of two New York plants into a single facility in Horseheads, N.Y., to achieve manufacturing effeciency and lower lead times.
It was not immediately available for further comment.

Thomas & Betts, which supplies electrical and electronic connectors, said it was investing in new equipment for the manufacturing facility to meet demands of the rapidly-growing cable television market.
It completed the acquisition of Augat Electronics in December for $550 million.
